estudio.title: Studio
estudio.body1: SM Studio is a design studio led by Sofía Mosquera, integrating interior design, custom furniture and original art in a single creative process.
estudio.body2: Unlike other studios, we believe a truly unique space cannot be designed in parts. The space, the furniture and the works that inhabit it are born from the same vision and the same hand. Nobody else does this.
estudio.body3: The space where you live and work says something about you. When it doesn't represent you, you feel it. We create space experiences: we design the interior, build the furniture and create the artworks —all from the same vision.

servicios.title: Services
servicios.01body: Participation during the construction process, with input on spatial and architectural decisions that optimize functionality, material coherence and adaptation of the space to the lifestyle of its users.
servicios.02body: Complete conceptual and technical development once architecture is defined. Includes furniture design specific to each space, materiality, lighting, equipment and execution oversight.
servicios.03body: Development of custom pieces and systems, panelling, libraries and specific equipment, coordinating fabrication and installation.
servicios.04body: Selection and provision of textiles, objects, decorative lighting and complementary elements, ensuring aesthetic coherence and final commissioning of the space.

muebles.title: Furniture
muebles.tagline: Each piece is born from the space it will inhabit. Designed, built and installed by the studio.
muebles.placeholder: Meanwhile, we design and build custom furniture for each project. Reach out about your ideal piece.
muebles.personalizeTitle: Can't find what you're looking for?
muebles.personalizeBody: All our pieces can be adapted in dimensions, materials and finishes. Tell us what you need.
muebles.customBody: Dimensions, woods and finishes can be adapted to your project. Production lead time 45-60 days.

arte.title: Art
arte.intro: Art as a path to decipher the interior. Four series where each canvas is a radiography of the present —emotions, maps, movement and solidity— captured in color and matter.
